units.text: Matches any “word” character. A “word” character is any letter or digit or the underscore character.
units.sourceHTML: Matches any “word” character. A “word” character is any letter or digit or the underscore character.

units.text: Matches a word boundary; that is it matches if the character to the left is a “word” character and the character to the right is a “non-word” character, or vice-versa.

units.text: Matches everywhere but on a word boundary; that is it matches if the character to the left and the character to the right are either both “word” characters or both “non-word” characters.
